dash.greeting_sub: The rest can wait. Clear these and you are ahead for the day.
dash.today_sub: Ordered by how soon they stop being possible.
dash.empty_body: Applications with no answer land here after {days} days. Until then the ball is with the employer.
list.sub: Which CV went where, what you quoted, and who answered.
list.empty_body: Add your first application — or an offer you are still deciding on.
list.no_match_body: Try another word, or clear the status filter.
detail.note_placeholder: e.g. second round with the team
detail.delete_body: With the offer and its whole history. This cannot be undone.
form.intro_new: Record something you sent — or an offer you are still deciding on.
form.intro_edit: Correcting a detail changes the record, not its history.
form.what_you_sent_hint: In six months this is the part that matters
form.submitted_on_hint: Empty means today. Set it when catching up on older applications.
form.blocked_reason_placeholder: External form, CV upload by hand
form.notes_placeholder: Who answered, what they asked, what still needs sending.
form.add_cv_hint: A version is just a label — we do not store the file.
form.footnote: Status changes later — the history records every move.
answers.sub: The questions every recruitment form asks. Written once, pasted afterwards — so October's answer matches August's.
answers.label: For which question
answers.value_placeholder: One month, ending on the last day of the month.
answers.empty_body: Add the ones you retype from form to form.
answers.error_empty: Both a question and an answer are needed.
answers.error_duplicate: You already have an answer labelled “{label}”.
account.export_body: Plain CSV, one row per record. Opens in Sheets, Excel and LibreOffice — nothing is locked to Offerly.
account.close_body: Deletes every application, offer, company, CV version, answer and the account itself. It happens immediately and cannot be undone — export first if you want to keep anything.
account.error_wrong_email: That is not the address this account signs in with.
auth.welcome_sub: See who answered, and what needs a move.
auth.have_code_sub: Offerly is in early development — accounts start from an invite code.
auth.privacy_note: We hold no tokens or passwords for your mailbox. You get a private address and decide what to forward.
auth.reset_sub: Enter the address you sign in with and we will send a link.
auth.set_sub: Choose something you have not used elsewhere.
auth.link_dead: Open the link from the email again, or
auth.reset_sent: If that address has an account, a link to set a new password is on its way. It expires in an hour.
auth.error_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.error_short_password: Password must be at least 10 characters.
auth.error_bad_invite: This invite code is not valid.
auth.error_signup_failed: Could not create the account. Is the email already registered?
auth.error_link_expired: This link has expired or has already been used.
auth.error_password_refused: Could not set that password. Try a different one.
palette.label: Quick actions
palette.placeholder: Type where you want to go…
confirm.delete_application_body: The application, the offer and the whole status history go. We keep no copy.
confirm.delete_account_title: Delete the account and everything in it?
confirm.delete_account_body: It happens immediately. CSV export will not be possible afterwards.
